stories.label: India · Due process
stories.head: Custody extended after Jantar Mantar protest
bullets: Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das have been held since 13 October.
They entered Jantar Mantar after it was denotified as a protest site.
Delhi Police did not respond to a request for comment; their party will appeal.
